name: 婚礼流程时间节点倒计时

map.设定婚礼日期，自动生成筹备里程碑时间线，每节点含待办清单与倒计时。: Set your wedding date to generate a preparation milestone timeline, with a task list and countdown for every milestone.
map.请选择婚礼日期，系统将自动生成\"订婚→领证→婚庆策划→试妆→彩排→婚礼当天\": Pick a wedding date and the tool generates a milestone timeline covering engagement → marriage registration → wedding planning → makeup trial → rehearsal → the wedding day, scheduled by the recommended lead time and adjustable one by one. Click any milestone to expand its task list and tick items off to record progress. All data stays in your browser.
map.📚 深度解析：婚礼筹备里程碑时间线: 📚 In depth: the wedding preparation milestone timeline
map.定下婚期后生成从订婚、领证、找策划、试妆到彩排的里程碑节点，避免临期手忙脚乱。: Once the date is set, the tool lays out milestones from engagement and registration through finding a planner and a makeup trial to the rehearsal, so nothing is left to the last minute.
map.把每个里程碑配上待办清单，逐项勾选推进，直观看到整体进度。: Each milestone comes with a task list, so you can tick items off and see overall progress at a glance.
map.异地或长线筹备时按剩余天数倒排，先定酒店与策划这类需要提前锁定的项目。: For long-distance or long-lead planning, work backward from the days remaining and lock in the items that need booking early, such as the venue and the planner.
map.婚期倒推的里程碑: Milestones counted backward from the wedding date
map.婚期 2026-10-01 → 工具倒排出：提前 6–12 个月订酒店与婚庆策划: Wedding on 2026-10-01 → the tool works backward: 6–12 months ahead to book the venue and the planner, 3–4 months ahead for wedding photos and choosing the dress, 1 month ahead for the makeup trial and confirming the schedule, 1 week ahead for the rehearsal and checking the materials. Each milestone lists the tasks for that stage, and ticking them off reduces the remaining count in real time — handy for a weekly planning check-in.
map.里程碑的天数能改吗？: Can I change the number of days for a milestone?
map.可以。工具给出的是通用倒排建议，各地酒店与热门档期的紧张程度不同，遇到旺季应把订: Yes. The tool offers general backward-scheduling guidance, but venue and peak-season availability vary by location — during busy periods, book the venue and planner another 2–3 months earlier.
map.不会。清单状态只存在当前页面，刷新后回到初始状态。需要长期跟踪请把进度复制或截图: No. Checklist state lives only on the current page and resets on refresh. For long-term tracking, copy the progress out or take a screenshot.
map.婚礼筹备全流程倒计时工具，自动生成订婚、领证、婚庆策划、试妆、彩排、婚礼当天等里: A countdown tool for the whole wedding-preparation process. It generates milestones for engagement, marriage registration, wedding planning, the makeup trial, the rehearsal and the wedding day, each with its own task list and progress tracking, so you can prepare calmly.
map.六大婚礼里程碑自动排期: Six key wedding milestones scheduled automatically
map.每节点独立待办清单，可增删: A separate, editable task list for every milestone
map.勾选完成项，自动计算进度: Tick items off and progress is calculated for you
map.时间线可视化，标记当前节点: A visual timeline that highlights the current milestone
